name: agent
title: Agent transport
description: Reaches a channel through a local agent harness — how Gmail is read today.

connector.label: Connector
connector.hint: This is the CHANNEL, and half of every thread key. Leaving it empty forks every thread in the mailbox — permanently.

harness.label: Harness
harness.hint: The worker CLI that runs the fetch. Without a launchable one the source parks on config_error.
